review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer( Network Operations )-Senior Enterprise Communications Engineer
review_candidates.description: 190928 Overview The Senior Network Engineer is responsible for the operational support, maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Northwell Health's enterprise network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPN, internet connectivity, and Google Cloud networking environments. This is a senior-level, hands-on engineering role requiring strong technical troubleshooting skills, operational ownership, and the ability to independently manage complex network incidents in a large, highly available healthcare environment. The successful candidate must be capable of troubleshooting across technologies, performing root-cause analysis, executing production changes, and driving issues through resolution with minimal supervision. On-Call and Location Requirements Must be willing and able to participate in a rotating on-call schedule that includes nights, weekends, holidays, and emergency response for critical network incidents. Ability to support operational and onsite requirements as needed in Long Island/Suffolk County Required Technical Skills Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking and the OSI model, with the ability to apply these concepts during real-world troubleshooting. Advanced experience supporting enterprise routing and switching environments. Strong working knowledge of routing protocols, including BGP and EIGRP. Experience troubleshooting VLANs, trunks, spanning tree, routing, ACLs, NAT, DNS, DHCP, MTU, latency, packet loss, and network performance issues. Experience with enterprise WAN technologies and geographically distributed network environments. Working knowledge of enterprise wireless networking and troubleshooting. Experience with firewalls, remote-access VPN technologies, and network-security fundamentals. Experience using packet captures, network monitoring tools, logs, CLI diagnostics, and performance data to isolate complex issues. Knowledge of cloud networking, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including VPCs, routing, connectivity, and hybrid-cloud architectures. Ability to independently troubleshoot complex production issues across multiple network domains and technologies. Preferred Certifications Cisco CCNP Palo Alto Networks certifications Google Cloud certifications Other relevant enterprise networking, security, wireless, or cloud certifications 7-10 years of relevant experience, preferred Technology Experience Preferred Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable: Cisco enterprise routing and switching Palo Alto Networks firewalls and Panorama Enterprise wireless technologies SD-WAN technologies Google Cloud networking Enterprise VPN technologies Network monitoring and observability platforms ServiceNow or similar IT service-management platforms Job Description Ensures integrity of the network devices, communication systems software, hardware. Develops and conducts in-service training on new applications. Responsible for identifying, engineering/designing and programming of networking infrastructure and communication applications.
